title: Zariski local monoid lifts of a prescribed characteristic fan chart
statement:
Let $(V,N)$ be a locally Noetherian fs log scheme [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] whose log structure is associated to one on the Zariski site, and write $\overline N=N/\mathcal O_V^\times$ on that site. Let $F$ be a fine fan [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup], and let $c:(V,\overline N)\to(F,\mathcal P_F)$ be a local morphism of sharp monoidal spaces with $c^{-1}\mathcal P_F\simeq\overline N$. For each $v\in V$ put $z=c(v)$ and $P=\mathcal P_{F,z}$. The subset $F_z$ consisting of all generalizations of $z$ is an open affine fan canonically isomorphic to the sharpened spectrum of $P$. The monoid $P\simeq\overline N_v$ is sharp fine saturated and $P^{\mathrm{gp}}$ is free abelian of finite rank.
There exist a Zariski open neighborhood $U\subseteq c^{-1}(F_z)$ of $v$ and a homomorphism $h:P\to\Gamma(U,N)$ which is a log chart and whose sharpening is precisely $c|_U$ under this identification of $F_z$. Equivalently, its homomorphism $P\to\Gamma(U,\overline N)$ is the prescribed one induced by $c$, and the associated log structure of $\alpha h$ is $N|_U$. The homomorphism on $P^{\mathrm{gp}}$ at $v$ can be any group section of $N_v^{\mathrm{gp}}\to\overline N_v^{\mathrm{gp}}$ under the displayed identification.

source.place: Expose VIII 3.1.4(iii), 3.1.8(ii), 3.1.10(ii), pp.98--100; 3.3.12--3.3.13, pp.108--109: Zariski local lift expanded using free characteristic groups (VI 1.6, p.70).

proof.text: Obtain the canonical stalk model: a normalized fan localization L, the equivalence Associates R ≃ P normalized by the actual quotient, integrality of R, and the fs sharp finite-free properties of P.

Extend that equivalence to group completions by the universal property; transport a finite basis. Apply integral monoid free-sharpening splitting to R. Transport its group section to P^gp. For any prescribed section s and p in P choose a representative r of p. The element s(p)/r has trivial quotient, so the kernel clause gives a unit v of R representing it. Thus s(p) equals v*r in the completion. Injectivity of R in its completion makes these representatives multiplicative and yields a monoid section j with the specified groupification.

Spread j to U,h,a with exact germ and prescribed characteristic sections. Apply the characteristic fan criterion to h. Its germ equation and the monoid-section groupification give the required last equality for the originally prescribed s.

Steps: (1) P ≅ N̄_v is sharp fs with free gp, via fan-point localization plus the chart face quotient and fs-face-sharpening. (2) Every group section t restricts to a monoid section, since t(p)−l lies in ker π = A^×. (3) Finite presentation gives a homomorphism h after finite shrinking, with h̄ = ρ_c. (4) Locality shows the prime of c(y) is P∖E; surjectivity and the injectivity algebra u·αh(e) = u'·αh(e') check out. (5) 03PU on geometric stalks plus ILO 3.1.8(ii) gives equality of the sharpenings. The new node is true: étale logification stalk is L⊕_{A^×}B^×, units act freely because N_x̄ is integral, so L is integral, and N_x̄/B^× = (Q−E)/E^gp. Tested on trivial log, standard log point and a singular fs cone. C5 fault: the new node's pushout and characteristic isomorphisms are exactly the stalk formulas of the existing same-unit node lem-trf-zariski-prelog-logification-comparison (Q17, on base) applied with P = N_Z, a node the report's not-duplicate list missed.
